DomainsPage.title: Domains
DomainsPage.subtitle: Reach your containers with your own domain names and HTTPS.
DomainsPage.loadFailed: Could not load the domain settings of this environment.
DomainsPage.blockedTitle: A proxy is already in the way
DomainsPage.blockedExisting: This environment already runs a reverse proxy (Traefik or Caddy) that Shipir does not manage. To avoid two proxies fighting over the same ports, Shipir does not set up another one here.
DomainsPage.blockedPorts: Port 80 or 443 is already used by a container on this environment. A reverse proxy needs both ports, so stop or move that container first.
DomainsPage.adminOnly: Only administrators can set up the reverse proxy. Ask an administrator to set it up, then you can publish containers here.
DomainsPage.readyText: The reverse proxy is managed by Shipir and routes your domains to your containers.
DomainsPage.noDomainsHint: Published domains will be listed here.
DomainsPage.setupFailed: The setup did not finish. Check the output above and the proxy deployment for details.
ProxySetupCard.title: Set up the reverse proxy
ProxySetupCard.intro: A reverse proxy listens on ports 80 and 443 and sends each domain to the right container. Shipir runs it for you.
ProxySetupCard.traefikDesc: Popular and flexible. Supports wildcard certificates.
ProxySetupCard.caddyDesc: Simple and lightweight. Certificates just work.
ProxySetupCard.emailHelpRequired: Let’s Encrypt sends expiry warnings here.
ProxySetupCard.emailHelpOptional: Optional. Let’s Encrypt sends expiry warnings here.
ProxySetupCard.emailRequired: Enter an e-mail address for Let’s Encrypt.
ProxySetupCard.automaticDesc: Free certificates, requested and renewed for you.
ProxySetupCard.ownDesc: Use a certificate you bought or created yourself.
ProxySetupCard.ownNote: The proxy starts with automatic Let’s Encrypt certificates as its default. Once it runs, upload your own certificate under Your certificates and assign it to a domain.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to set up the reverse proxy here.
errors.proxyExists: This environment already has a proxy managed by Shipir.
errors.setupBlocked: Another proxy is already running, or port 80 or 443 is in use on this environment. Free the ports and try again.
errors.unsupported: This option is not supported by the chosen proxy. Pick Traefik or change the setting.
errors.invalidEmail: This e-mail address does not look valid.
errors.noEncryptionKey: The server has no encryption key configured, so the setup cannot store its settings.
CertificatesSection.title: Your certificates
CertificatesSection.intro: Certificates you uploaded yourself. Assign one to a domain when you publish a container.
CertificatesSection.name: Name
CertificatesSection.loadFailed: Could not load the certificates of this environment.
CertificatesSection.emptyAdmin: Upload a certificate you bought or created yourself, together with its private key. Shipir stores the key encrypted and never shows it again.
CertificatesSection.emptyReadOnly: There are no certificates to show. Only administrators can upload certificates, so ask an administrator if you need one for a domain.
CertificatesSection.deleteText: The certificate and its key are removed from the proxy. This cannot be undone.
CertificateDialog.uploadIntro: Paste the certificate chain and the private key, or pick the files.
CertificateDialog.renewIntro: Upload the new certificate chain and its private key. Domains using this certificate switch over right away.
CertificateDialog.name: Name
CertificateDialog.nameHelp: Only for you, to tell certificates apart.
CertificateDialog.nameRequired: Enter a name for the certificate.
CertificateDialog.chainHelp: PEM format, your certificate first, then the intermediate certificates.
CertificateDialog.keyHelp: PEM format, without a password. It is never shown again after you send it.
certErrors.invalidName: The name must be 1 to 100 characters long.
certErrors.nameTaken: This name is already used by another certificate.
certErrors.invalidCertificate: This does not look like a valid PEM certificate chain.
certErrors.notYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet.
certErrors.doesNotCover: The new certificate does not cover every domain that currently uses this one.
certErrors.invalidKey: This does not look like a valid PEM private key.
certErrors.keyEncrypted: This key is protected by a password. Remove the password first, then upload it again.
certErrors.keyMismatch: This key does not belong to this certificate. Check that you picked the matching key.
certErrors.tooLarge: The certificate or key is too large.
certErrors.inUse: This certificate is still used by {{routes}}. Switch those domains to another certificate first.
certErrors.notFound: This certificate no longer exists. Reload the page.
CertificateDialog.fileTooLarge: This file is too large (the limit is {{size}} KB). Check that you picked the right file.
CertificateDialog.fileUnreadable: Could not read this file. Try again or paste the contents.
RoutesList.title: Published domains
RoutesList.intro: Each domain sends visitors to one of your containers, with HTTPS.
RoutesList.loadFailed: Could not load the published domains.
RoutesList.emptyWriter: Publish a container to reach it with your own domain name.
RoutesList.emptyReader: Nothing is published on this environment yet.
RoutesList.unpublishText: The domain stops pointing to the container. The container itself keeps running.
PublishDialog.title: Publish a container
PublishDialog.intro: Choose a container and the domain it should answer to. Shipir sets up the rest.
PublishDialog.editIntro: Change the domain or the port. Other settings of this route stay as they are.
PublishDialog.candidatesFailed: Could not load the containers of this environment.
PublishDialog.noContainers: There are no containers on this environment.
PublishDialog.domainHelp: The name visitors type, for example app.example.com. It must already point to this server.
PublishDialog.hostnameProblem.tooLong: This domain name is too long.
PublishDialog.hostnameProblem.wildcardNo: Wildcard domains need the DNS challenge, which this proxy is not set up for.
PublishDialog.hostnameProblem.invalid: Enter a full domain name such as app.example.com, with letters, digits and hyphens only.
PublishDialog.portSeveral: This container listens on several ports. Which one should the domain use?
PublishDialog.portNone: Shipir could not detect a port. Enter the port the container listens on.
PublishDialog.portChoose: Choose the port the container listens on.
routeErrors.forbidden: You are not allowed to change published domains.
routeErrors.hostTaken: This domain is already used by another route.
routeErrors.invalidHostname: This is not a valid domain name.
routeErrors.wildcard: Wildcard domains need the DNS challenge or your own certificate.
routeErrors.invalidContainer: This container cannot be published. Reload the list and pick another one.
routeErrors.portRequired: Choose the port the container listens on.
routeErrors.proxyMissing: Set up the reverse proxy first, then publish your container.
routeErrors.routeNotFound: This domain no longer exists. Reload the page.
routeErrors.attachFailed: Shipir could not connect the container to the proxy network. Check that the container exists and try again.
routeErrors.syncFailed: Shipir could not update the proxy. Check the proxy deployment and try again.
PublishDialog.editIntroAdvanced: Change the domain, the port or any of the advanced options below.
PublishDialog.advanced.title: Advanced options
PublishDialog.advanced.aliasesHelp: More names that lead to the same container. All of them use the same certificate settings.
PublishDialog.advanced.pathPrefixHelp: Only requests below this path reach the container, for example /blog. Leave empty for the whole domain.
PublishDialog.advanced.schemeHelp: How the proxy talks to the container.
PublishDialog.advanced.entrypointHelp: Name of the Traefik entrypoint. Leave empty for the default.
PublishDialog.advanced.noCertificates: No certificates uploaded yet. Upload one in the certificates section.
PublishDialog.advanced.redirectHelp: Visitors who open the plain http address are sent to the secure one.
PublishDialog.advanced.basicAuthHelp: Visitors must log in with one of these users. Passwords are stored as a hash and are never shown again. Leave a stored user’s password empty to keep it.
PublishDialog.advanced.headersHelp: Headers the proxy adds to every answer, for example X-Frame-Options.
PublishDialog.advanced.hiddenProblem: Some advanced options are not valid. Turn on Advanced mode to see and fix them.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.tooMany: You can add at most 20 entries here.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.aliasInva: Enter full domain names in lower case, such as www.example.com.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.aliasWild: Wildcard names need the DNS challenge or your own certificate.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.pathInval: The path must start with / and may only contain letters, digits and . _ ~ - /
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.userInval: User names may only contain letters, digits and . _ -
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.passwordR: A new user needs a password.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.userDupli: Each user name can be used only once.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.headerInv: Use plain letters, digits and hyphens for the name, and plain text without quotes, backslashes, backticks, $, braces or angle brackets for the value.
PublishDialog.advanced.problem.headerDup: Each header can be set only once.
routeErrors.advanced.TOO_MANY_ALIASES: A domain can have at most 20 extra names.
routeErrors.advanced.INVALID_PATH_PREFIX: This path prefix is not valid. It must start with /.
routeErrors.advanced.INVALID_ENTRYPOINT: This entrypoint name is not valid.
routeErrors.advanced.CERT_NOT_FOUND: This certificate no longer exists. Reload the page.
routeErrors.advanced.CERT_DOES_NOT_COVER: The chosen certificate does not cover every domain name of this route.
routeErrors.advanced.UNSUPPORTED_FOR_PRO: An option you chose is not supported by this proxy. Turn on Advanced mode and check the entrypoint and the certificate type.
routeErrors.advanced.INVALID_BASIC_AUTH: The password-protected users are not valid.
routeErrors.advanced.TOO_MANY_USERS: A domain can have at most 20 users.
routeErrors.advanced.TOO_MANY_HEADERS: A domain can have at most 20 response headers.
routeErrors.advanced.INVALID_HEADER: A response header is not valid.
routeErrors.advanced.INVALID_ROUTE: Some of the options do not fit together. Check the advanced options.
errors.dnsInUse: Domains still use the DNS challenge. Switch them to another certificate type before you remove the DNS credentials.
errors.dnsCredentialsRequired: The DNS challenge needs a DNS provider and its credentials.
ProxySettingsPanel.title: Proxy settings
ProxySettingsPanel.intro: Defaults for new domains and the DNS challenge. Changing the DNS settings restarts the proxy for a moment.
ProxySettingsPanel.defaultModeHelp: Used for new domains unless you pick something else for them.
ProxySettingsPanel.providerHelp: The provider code of your DNS service, for example cloudflare. It is needed for wildcard certificates.
ProxySettingsPanel.stored: Credentials are stored ({{hint}}). They are never shown again.
ProxySettingsPanel.credentialsHelp: Enter the variables your provider needs. Everything you enter replaces the stored credentials.
ProxySettingsPanel.credentialsRequired: Changing the DNS provider needs its credentials. Enter them below.
ProxySettingsPanel.savedRestart: Settings saved. The proxy is restarting with the new settings.
ProxySettingsPanel.providerRequired: Enter the DNS provider code, for example cloudflare.
ProxySettingsPanel.providerInvalid: This is not a valid provider code. Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 40 characters.
ProxySettingsPanel.variableInvalid: Variable names must be upper case letters, digits and underscores, start with a letter and not be ACME_EMAIL or DNS_PROVIDER.
ProxySettingsPanel.valueInvalid: Every variable needs a value of 1 to 2000 characters without line breaks or control characters.
ProxySettingsPanel.tooManyVariables: You can enter at most 10 variables.
ProxySettingsPanel.replaceFirst: To change the DNS provider, click Replace credentials first and enter the credentials of the new provider.
errors.deploymentMissing: The proxy deployment no longer exists. Remove the proxy and set it up again.
